player_prompt.intro:
A si Player {player_id}. A si ɓeyda Guess The Number.
A si ɓeyda ɗon haɗi numeeru ɓuri ɓaleeji {min_number} e {max_number} nder {max_turns} turnaaku.
Tawa a yahri ɓe ɗon haɗirka, ceeɗe ɓe ɗon woodi ko ɓe haɗi ɓe ɗon ɗoofta kadi 'inɗee' bee 'wolde'.
A ɓe woodi ɓe ɗon haɗirka ɓe ɗon ɗoofta e ɓuri haa. Ko numeeru ɓuri ɓaleeji moƴe ɓe ɗon haɗi ɓe ɗon ɗoofta e kawrii ɓe ɗon ɗoofta, ɓe ɗon ɗoofta ɓe ɗon haɗi ɓe ɗon ɗoofta. Kadi, [5].
Tawa a ɓeyda, ɓe ɗon haɗirka ɓe ɗon ɗoofta ɓe ɗon haɗi ɓe ɗon ɗoofta nder ɓaleeji. Siɗɗa ɓe ɗon haɗirka ɓe ɗon ɗoofta e ɓuri haa ɓe ɗon ɗoofta ceeɗe ɓe ɗon haɗi ɓe ɗon ɗoofta ɓe ɗon ɗoofta.Ɓe ɗon haɗi ɓe ɗon ɗoofta.
